cases.name: wheels_unseen_figures_full

payload.objective: Destroy the rebel cell in the sector

expect.canon:
mission=vector|wheels_unseen_figures_full
round=2
posture=eliminate
objective=Destroy the rebel cell in the sector
objective_actor=
threat=0
threatseen=0
seq=3
G|DG002|DG002|1|0|3|3|1|4|5/6
expect.objective: Destroy the rebel cell in the sector

cases._arith: M9-F6/A0 ground truth: 3 figures printed health 4 -> hp 12; only figure 0 moved its dial (2 damage suffered); unseen figures 1+2 keep FULL HP (no dial event = dial 0, never guessed from absence). remaining = 12-2 = 10 -> 10/12 = 5/6. The OLD wheel-as-life reading would have said 2/12 = 1/6. Canon group line expects G|DG002|DG002|1|0|3|3|1|4|5/6.

cases.name: wheels_dial_clamped_over_health

cases._arith: M9-F6/A0 ground truth (Karten-Beispiel '2er-Gruppe health4+Rad[3,1]=1/4'): 2 figures printed health 2 (printed group HP 4); dial 3 EXCEEDS health and clamps to 2 (dead figure, floor 0 remaining), dial 1 -> 1 remaining. remaining = 0+1 = 1 -> 1/4. Canon group line expects G|DG003|DG003|1|0|2|2|1|2|1/4.
